name: Distorted-delay return: drive → ping-pong delay on a 100%-wet send, both band-limited to high mids, return pre-attenuated, played by riding the send
goal: Add crunchy, wide echo throws to a lead/pluck without mud or volume spikes: on a send/return insert drive then ping-pong delay, band-limit both to the high mids so lows aren't delayed, feedback ~56%, both 100% wet; dial drive/tone at maximum send, then pull the return down ~−6 dB as a safety ceiling, and perform/draw send-level automation so only chosen notes throw distorted echoes — the delta vs our ping-pong delay skill is drive-before-delay on a return and send-throw performance.

source.title: Ableton Sound Design Tutorial - Distorted Delays

prerequisites: Overdrive/distortion with a pre-filter band (or Biquad bandpass → WaveShaper)

inputs.name: lead
inputs.description: Lead/pluck melody on its own track

constraints: Original synthesis recipe; not affiliated with any vendor named in the source. Recreate in browser/Web Audio (Polyrhythm Studio) or any hybrid synth with comparable modules; no presets, banks or samples copied.
Keep low mids out of the delay — delayed low mids muddy the track.
Return set at about −6 dB before dialing tone avoids level spikes when the send is maxed.

steps.action: Create a spare return. Insert overdrive then delay (ping-pong).
Set the overdrive's pre-filter to the high mids only, and do the same on the delay's filter so only that band is delayed.
steps.expect: Echoes crunch in the high mids, low mids untouched

steps.action: Delay: ping-pong for width, feedback ~56%; both devices 100% wet so only effect signal returns.
Turn the send to maximum and dial drive and tone to the desired timbre.
steps.expect: Character of the distorted echoes set

steps.action: Pull the return fader down (~−6 dB start) so maxed sends never produce super-loud output.
Perform: jam the send knob live to feel where echoes should happen, then tidy or draw send automation per note (some full, some partial).
steps.expect: Only chosen notes throw distorted echoes

steps.action: Check in context with the full track and adjust.
steps.expect: Echoes add interest without masking the lead

verification: With send at zero, the lead is completely dry.
Echoes contain little low-mid energy (spectrum check).
Maxing the send doesn't spike output above the dry lead's level.
